posts.text: My thesis on Sheela Foam is basically: The Kurlon acquisition has made them the largest player in the organized mattress market in India. They are backward integrated through their foam business, which gives them control over an important raw material. There is a large opportunity from the shift from unorganized to organized mattresses. They have a cheaper range to bring more customers into the organized market, while also moving towards premiumization.
